name: v47_fast_earnings_slow_window
hypothesis: Slower rank windows may preserve the fast earnings evaluation signal while reducing turnover enough to lift Fitness.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_bee_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_ssc_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_60_days, 90), industry)

name: v47_fast_earnings_lower_turnover_126
hypothesis: A 126-day rank and higher decay should materially reduce turnover if signal persistence is real.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_bee_fast_d1), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_ssc_fast_d1), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: More aggressive turnover reduction; watch signal decay.

name: v47_fast_earnings_relevance_filter
hypothesis: Adding event relevance at modest weight may improve robustness without moving into M&A/credit/legal news.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_bee_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_ssc_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_event_relevance_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Tests whether relevance should be positive for fast earnings news, unlike v46 low-relevance generic news.

name: v47_fast_earnings_story_count_positive
hypothesis: For earnings evaluation, more story-event records may confirm the signal instead of being noise.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_bee_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_ssc_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Opposite sign of story count vs KPbrjG81.

name: v47_fast_earnings_no_generic_sentiment
hypothesis: Removing generic fast sentiment may reduce overlap with e7OQoveE and other event-sentiment actives.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_bee_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: More earnings-specific, fewer generic sentiment components.

name: v47_fast_earnings_industry_neutral
hypothesis: Industry neutralization may improve sub-universe stability for fast earnings events, though correlation must be checked.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_bee_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_ssc_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_60_days, 90), industry)
